# Archived issue templates

Retired versions of the GitHub issue forms in `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`. Files
here are inert: GitHub only reads templates from `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`
itself, so nothing in this folder appears in the issue picker.

Each file is named `<original-name>.<retirement-date>.yml`.

| File | Retired | Why |
|------|---------|-----|
| `bug_report.2026-08-05.yml` | 2026-08-05 | Redirected reporters to the ROCm repository and asked for a ROCm version, but this tracker covers playbook content across ROCm, Lemonade, and Ryzen AI NPU workflows. Replaced with a playbook-scoped form that uses the repository's own device IDs. |
| `config.2026-08-05.yml` | 2026-08-05 | Linked to the ROCm issue tracker and the AMD Community Forum. Replaced with the AMD Developer Discord as the discussion venue. |
